No unsolicited agency referrals please.  
  
Job Title: Lead Systems Engineer  
Position: Lead Systems Engineer Network Security  
Experience: 8+ Years  
Category: Infrastructure /Cloud  
Location: Bangalore  
Position ID: J1026-1291  
Employment Type: Full-time  
  
Role Type: Full time . Level: Lead Engineer (Delivery & Execution)Location: Bangalore . Reports to: Network Infrastructure ManagerTeams interfaced: Architecture, Business Units, Security, PMO, Service Desk, Vendors  
  
Role Summary:  
We are seeking a Lead Network Engineer with strong hands on expertise in data center networking and security technologies to deliver and operate critical infrastructure. This role follows the “You deploy, you run” model—meaning you will implement solutions and also support them in production. Responsibilities include preparing Low Level Designs (LLDs) from High Level Designs (HLDs), executing deployments, managing incidents, and ensuring operational stability. You will also work closely with business and technical teams to communicate progress, risks, and outcomes throughout the project lifecycle and BAU operations.  
  
Key Responsibilities:  
Project Lifecycle & Delivery  
  
. Participate in project initiation by reviewing HLDs and understanding scope, timelines, and dependencies.  
. Prepare LLDs, configuration templates, and implementation plans based on approved HLDs.  
. Execute build, configuration, and deployment activities for network and security components.  
. Conduct testing and validation (UAT, failover, performance) before production cutover.  
. Support go live activities, including risk mitigation and rollback planning.  
. Track and report project progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and PMO.  
  
  
Operations & Service Delivery  
  
. Own the deployed solutions in production—monitor, maintain, and optimize performance.  
. Act as L3 escalation point for critical incidents and complex changes.  
. Drive root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.  
. Maintain accurate change records and adhere to ITIL processes.  
. Ensure compliance with security and audit requirements.  
  
  
  
Stakeholder Communication  
  
. Provide clear updates on incident status, project progress, and risks to business and technical teams.  
. Collaborate with architecture, security, and application teams to align on requirements and timelines.  
  
Operational Excellence  
  
. Maintain network diagrams, LLDs, and configuration repositories.  
. Support audits and compliance requirements for security and infrastructure.  
. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.  
  
  
Core Technology Scope  
  
. Networking: BGP, OSPF, EVPN/VXLAN, MPLS, QoS  
. Data Center Platforms: Cisco Nexus / ACI  
. Security: Firewalls: Palo Alto, Check Point (policy, NAT, VPN) VPN (F5), NAC (Cisco ISE/ClearPass)  
. SD WAN: Managed service as part of SASE model (candidate will interface, not configure end to end)  
. Secure Web Gateway: Zscaler (basic awareness; not primary responsibility)  
. Load Balancing: F5 BIG IP, Citrix Netscaler  
. Automation: Ansible, Python, Git (preferred)  
. Tooling: ThousandEyes, NetFlow tools  
  
Requirements:  
  
. 10+ years in network engineering with strong hands on experience in data center networking and security.  
. Proven ability to prepare LLDs and execute deployments based on HLDs.  
. Expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex network/security issues.  
. Familiarity with SD WAN and SASE concepts (managed service coordination).  
. Strong understanding of ITIL processes and change governance.  
. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  
  
  
Preferred Certifications  
  
. CCNP/CCIE  
. Palo Alto PCNSE, Check Point CCSA/CCSE  
. F5 CTS, VMware VCP NV  
. Automation skills (Ansible, Python)  
  
  
Success Metrics  
  
. On time delivery of projects and changes  
. Reduction in incident MTTR  
. Compliance with security and audit standards  
. Positive stakeholder feedback

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  
  
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Digital Systems Engineer - 3D CAD
description:
Total Number of Openings

1

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

**About the position**

The Digital Systems Engineer is part of the Engineering Services Team within the Chevron ENGINE Center and will be responsible for creating and maintaining detailed 3D models of facilities, equipment, and systems. This role involves using advanced CAD software to develop accurate and efficient models that support engineering design, visualization, and analysis.

They will be responsible for delivery of 3D scans and models of petrochemical facilities for Digital Twin deployments across various assets. Collaborate with consultants, engineers, and project managers to ensure the quality and timely completion of projects. Oversee AVEVA E3D setup and administration, database management, clash manager configuration, report customization, MDS customization (support modeling), creation and management of user-defined attributes (UDAs), spooler setup, and catalogue and specification building in a global environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Use advanced techniques and tools to capture the accurate geometry and dimensions of the assets and create realistic 3D models that can be used for design, analysis, and simulation purposes.
* Audit the quality of 3D models being delivered by 3rd party providers for correctness and adherence to company standards.
* Guide clients and stakeholders in specifying expectations to third parties for large-scale, outsourced 3D modelling efforts. Clearly outline and communicate these expectations for inclusion in contract documents and/or specifications.
* Support / Guide the design team for any issues (all disciplines)  
  Create macros in Programmable Macro Language (PML) to automate simple tasks like adding or updating UDAs, extraction of Navisworks/Review files, etc.  
  Configure project-specific customizations using PML/PML II
* Set up the clash management and run clash reports.
* Generate custom reports from the 3D model as per project requirements.
* Integrate data from various sources and create intelligent asset visualizations for digital twins.  
  Programmatically upload attributes into 3D modelling software and extract data from 3D modelling software and compare them with other data sources.
* Diagnose issues and deviations from standards in existing 3D models of oil and gas facilities using AVEVA E3D software. Use advanced techniques and tools to rectify issues and update models to contain complete and accurate metadata attributes.
* Configure (including troubleshooting) and extract key deliverables like Material Take Off (MTO), piping isometrics, equipment lists, line lists, weight reports, etc.
* Preparation of 3D modelling guidelines and specifications, including lessons learned across assets
* Database creation and administration (including exporting, importing, clean-up, and merging databases)
* Loading and building catalogues and specifications
* Setting up users and databases, especially for collaboration between multiple companies (Chevron and Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) /contractors)  
  Create new catalogues for the projects as per vendor data for piping, equipment, structural, and electrical & instrumentation.
* Manage E3D/PDMS Global and E3D/PDMS Extract Databases. Coordinate with Systems lead in setting up global projects.
* Create local backups of running projects as necessary.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline (mechanical, chemical, etc.) (B.E./B.Tech.) from a deemed/recognized (AICTE) university
* Hands-on experience in relevant tools for laser scanning, point cloud data management, photogrammetry, data integration, data analysis software, cloud platforms, and digital twins.
You should also have knowledge of the latest technologies and innovations in these fields.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of work experience as a 3D CAD Administrator and Designer, with extensive knowledge of plant layout, piping design, and piping materials.
* Additionally, knowledge of instrumentation, mechanical systems, HVAC, electrical components, and civil/structural elements of plant operations is required.

**What we can offer you**

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.

**How to apply**

To be a part of our success, click **APPLY** to submit your application.  
Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

**Privacy and Terms and Conditions**

We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.

Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.

Terms of Use

“ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.

This job advertisement is intended to provide a general overview of the role and workplace environment. Role details and outcomes may vary based on business needs and individual performance.

Chevron participates in E-Verify in certain locations as required by law.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-10-23

  

Candidate profile (title) Who you are

Candidate profile (text) - Default language Are you passionate about improving co-worker experience through digital solutions? Within Coworker listening we are standing at an interesting transformation with our coworkers in the centre. How can we develop a product area for listening to our 180 000+ colleagues. Do you have a vision on how to build this modern stack setup or have you done it before and want to take it to the next level here at one of the largest Retail companies in the world?
  
  
We are looking for a System Engineer to support the Listening area within our Digital Workplace Domain. Together with the Product Owner, you will drive the daily business, operational excellence, and continuous improvement from a technical perspective. Working closely with vendors bought service engineering team and Engineering Community, you will ensure our platforms are secure, compliant, reliable, and aligned with Ingka standards.
  
  
You thrive in a role where technology, governance, and continuous improvement come together. You enjoy collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders to ensure solutions deliver value while meeting operational, security, and compliance requirements.

Key responsibilities (title) Your responsibilities

Key responsibilities (text) • Partner closely with the Product Owner to drive daily operations, service improvements, and vendor coordination.
  

* Own the technical lifecycle management of listening and survey platforms.
* Act as the technical lead for the Listening area and provide guidance on platform capabilities, limitations, and improvements.
* Ensure SaaS solutions, integrations, and technical services are secure, compliant, supported, and aligned with Ingka standards.
* Manage data platform configuration, technical administration, and application maintenance activities.
* Ensure that listening solutions and related data processes comply with privacy, data protection, retention, consent and cross-border data requirements.
* Coordinate upgrades, releases, patches, and technical improvements.
* Monitor service availability, performance, capacity, and operational health.
* Manage incidents, problems, risks, vulnerabilities, and technical debt in collaboration with vendors and support teams.
* Drive root cause analysis and continuous service improvements.
* Ensure operational documentation, support models, and knowledge articles are maintained and kept up to date.
* Act as the primary technical contact towards vendors and bought service teams.
* Support vendor evaluations, onboarding activities, contract renewals, and service reviews from a technical perspective.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by identifying technical opportunities, risks, and improvement initiatives.
* Drive automation, standardization, and operational excellence initiatives.

  
WE BELIEVE YOU HAVE
  
  

* Experience working as a System Engineer, Application Engineer, Technical Service Owner, IT Application Manager, or similar role.
* Strong experience within IT Application Management Services (AMS).
* Experience with survey platforms, employee listening solutions, or HR-related SaaS platforms is preferred.
* Knowledge of application lifecycle management, service operations, and technical governance.
* Experience working with external vendors and managed service providers.
* Knowledge of security, privacy, compliance, and risk management requirements.
* Understanding of cloud and SaaS operating models.
* Ability to engage in technical discussions with vendors, architects, developers, and engineers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with Agile ways of working and Jira.
* Experience supporting system integrations and troubleshooting complex technical issues.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Team vision ( title) Together as a team

Team vision (text) You will be part of the Digital Workplace Domain, where we enable a better everyday work life through modern digital experiences and services.
  
  
Our mission is to understand the needs of co-workers and continuously improve their experience by turning feedback and insights into meaningful actions. Working side by side with the Product Owner, you will form the core leadership team for the Listening area. While the Product Owner focuses on product direction, business priorities, stakeholder needs, and roadmap direction, you will ensure the technical foundation, operational excellence, security, compliance, and governance needed to deliver reliable and scalable services.  
  
  
  
We believe in:
  
  

* Putting co-workers first.
* Strong collaboration across business and technology.
* Security and compliance by design.
* Operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Ownership and accountability.
* Building trusted partnerships with stakeholders and vendors.

  
  
We can offer you:
  
  

* Technical responsible of globally used platform impacting thousands of co-workers.
* Opportunity to shape the future of the Co-worker Listening area.
* Collaboration with global business stakeholders, vendors, and technology teams.
* Exposure to Digital Workplace solutions, SaaS platforms, application management, and vendor governance.
* A flexible and collaborative working environment.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.
* The possibility to make a real impact on how co-workers experience digital products and services every day.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

description:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Engineering
**General Summary:**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Systems Engineer** to drive the architecture and development of next generation System\-on\-Chip (SoC) interconnect solutions powering data center, automotive, smartphone, notebook, tablet, XR, smart glasses, and emerging compute platforms.


The candidate will be a key member of the **NoC Systems Architecture Team** , responsible for defining system requirements, developing Network\-on\-Chip (NoC) architecture specifications, and collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines to deliver scalable, high\-performance, and power\-efficient SoC solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Interconnect Architecture and System Definition**

* Contribute to the definition and evolution of SoC interconnect and Network\-on\-Chip (NoC) architectures.
* Gather and analyze system requirements, understand product use cases, and translate them into interconnect architecture and functional specifications.
* Define performance, scalability, quality\-of\-service (QoS), coherency, and latency requirements for interconnect subsystems.
* Evaluate and recommend suitable NoC topologies, routing algorithms, arbitration mechanisms, and traffic management schemes.

**System Modeling and Analysis**

* Develop and utilize behavioral or analytical models to study NoC performance and design trade\-offs.
* Analyze system traffic patterns and data flows to optimize interconnect bandwidth, latency, and power efficiency.
* Collaborate with performance teams to validate architectural decisions through modeling and simulation.

**SoC Architecture Collaboration**

* Work closely with CPU, GPU, AI/ML, Multimedia, Memory, Security, Power, and other subsystem teams to define interconnect requirements.
* Develop a strong understanding of:



	+ SoC boot flows
	+ Security architecture
	+ Clock and reset architecture
	+ Power management architecture
	+ System\-level data flows and performance requirements

**Cross\-Functional Engagement**

* Partner with architecture, RTL design, verification, physical design, floorplanning, power, and silicon validation teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with global engineering teams across multiple sites to ensure alignment on interconnect architecture and implementation.
* Support post\-silicon validation efforts by correlating pre\-silicon assumptions with measured silicon behavior.

**Technology Leadership and Innovation**

* Stay current with evolving industry standards, including:



	+ ARM AMBA specifications
	+ CHI , AXI, AHB, ACE/ACE\-Lite protocols
	+ PCI Express (PCIe)
	+ CXL
	+ Ethernet
	+ UALink
	+ Coherency and virtualization technologies
	+ Low\-power design methodologies
* Drive continuous improvements in interconnect architecture, design methodologies, performance optimization, and power efficiency.
* Propose innovative architectural solutions for future generation NoC and interconnect technologies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **7 to 11 years** of experience in SoC architecture, SoC design, NoC architecture, or related system engineering roles.
* Strong understanding of on\-chip interconnect concepts and industry\-standard protocols, including:



	+ ARM CHI
	+ AXI/AHB
	+ ACE/ACE\-Lite
	+ NoC architectures and coherency concepts
* Good understanding of digital design fundamentals and RTL implementation concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with Verilog/SystemVerilog based RTL development and SoC design methodologies.
* Understanding of multi\-core ARMv8/ARMv9 architectures, cache coherency, memory hierarchy, and virtualization concepts.
* Familiarity with performance analysis, system modeling, and architectural trade\-off studies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience with large\-scale SoC architecture for data center, AI/ML, mobile, automotive, or high\-performance compute applications.
* Knowledge of PCIe, CXL, memory subsystems, coherency fabrics, and virtualization technologies.
* Experience working with performance modeling, silicon validation, or system\-level architecture analysis.
